<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#6441A5"/>

  <!-- status bar -->
  <g>
    <text x="24" y="21" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">9:41</text>
    <line x1="310" y1="17" x2="310" y2="21" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="315" y1="14" x2="315" y2="21" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="320" y1="11" x2="320" y2="21" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="334" cy="17" r="3" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="331" y1="17" x2="337" y2="17" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="350" y="11" width="22" height="11" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="352" y="13" width="16" height="7" rx="1.5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <rect x="373" y="14" width="2" height="5" rx="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  </g>

  <!-- compact Twitch logo -->
  <g>
    <polygon points="163,54 227,54 227,99 211,99 197,113 197,99 163,99" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <polygon points="169,60 221,60 221,94 207,94 194,106 194,94 169,94" fill="#6441A5"/>
    <rect x="181" y="68" width="6" height="17" fill="#000000"/>
    <rect x="202" y="68" width="6" height="17" fill="#000000"/>
    <polygon points="163,54 155,62 155,103 166,103 166,113 177,103 177,99 163,99" fill="#000000"/>
  </g>

  <text x="195" y="150" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="24" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">Welcome 🎉</text>
  <text x="195" y="177" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="400" fill="#FFFFFF">Sign in to continue watching live</text>

  <!-- email field -->
  <text x="32" y="215" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">Email</text>
  <g>
    <rect x="31" y="223" width="329" height="56" rx="8" fill="#000000" opacity="0.16"/>
    <rect x="31" y="221" width="329" height="56" rx="8" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <text x="47" y="256" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="400" fill="#000000">alex.morgan@email.com</text>
    <circle cx="338" cy="249" r="9" fill="#6441A5"/>
    <polyline points="333,249 337,253 344,245" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  </g>

  <!-- password field -->
  <text x="32" y="307" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">Password</text>
  <g>
    <rect x="31" y="315" width="329" height="56" rx="8" fill="#000000" opacity="0.16"/>
    <rect x="31" y="313" width="329" height="56" rx="8" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <text x="47" y="348" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="18" font-weight="700" letter-spacing="3" fill="#000000">••••••••••</text>
    <circle cx="337" cy="341" r="6" fill="none" stroke="#6441A5" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <line x1="329" y1="350" x2="345" y2="333" stroke="#6441A5" stroke-width="1.7"/>
  </g>

  <!-- remember and forgot -->
  <g>
    <rect x="32" y="397" width="18" height="18" rx="4" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <polyline points="36,406 40,410 47,402" fill="none" stroke="#6441A5" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <text x="58" y="411" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="400" fill="#FFFFFF">Remember me</text>
    <text x="358" y="411" text-anchor="end" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">Forgot password?</text>
  </g>

  <!-- login button -->
  <g>
    <rect x="31" y="445" width="329" height="57" rx="8" fill="#000000" opacity="0.2"/>
    <rect x="31" y="441" width="329" height="57" rx="8" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <text x="195" y="477" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">Log in</text>
  </g>

  <text x="195" y="539" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#FFFFFF80">New to Twitch?</text>
  <g>
    <rect x="118" y="555" width="154" height="42" rx="8" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="195" y="581" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">Create account</text>
  </g>

  <line x1="32" y1="628" x2="358" y2="628" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-opacity="0.35" stroke-width="1"/>

  <text x="195" y="660" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">Watch what you love, live.</text>
  <text x="195" y="687" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF80">Twitch mobile 8.4.2</text>

  <!-- bottom navigation -->
  <g opacity="0.72">
    <line x1="0" y1="716" x2="390" y2="716" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-opacity="0.28" stroke-width="1"/>
    <!-- home -->
    <polygon points="48,741 59,732 70,741" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <rect x="52" y="740" width="14" height="12" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="59" y="771" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">Home</text>
    <!-- browse -->
    <circle cx="146" cy="740" r="9" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="153" y1="747" x2="160" y2="754" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="146" y="771" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">Browse</text>
    <!-- following -->
    <circle cx="244" cy="736" r="4" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <ellipse cx="244" cy="747" rx="9" ry="5" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="244" y="771" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">Following</text>
    <!-- profile -->
    <circle cx="331" cy="737" r="4" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <ellipse cx="331" cy="748" rx="9" ry="5" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="331" y="771" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">Profile</text>
  </g>

  <!-- home indicator -->
  <rect x="145" y="823" width="100" height="4" rx="2" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.8"/>
</svg>
